resources.name: QM/MM electronic structure code (e.g., CP2K, ChemShell)

access.notes: Any open-source QM/MM code supporting hybrid DFT with Gaussian basis and user-defined polarisable force fields.

resources.notes: The agent may choose CP2K as the reference open-source implementation; the paper used ChemShell but an equivalent is acceptable.

resources.name: BB1K hybrid exchange-correlation functional
resources.notes: Published functional; implemented in most DFT codes (e.g., CP2K, NWChem).

resources.name: Triple-zeta-plus-polarisation Gaussian basis for Ga, N, Mg

access.notes: Standard basis sets; e.g., DZP/TZP from EMSL Basis Set Exchange.

resources.notes: The agent must obtain or construct the basis sets consistent with the published work.

resources.name: Polarisable-shell interatomic potentials for GaN
resources.notes: Published in Philos. T. Roy. Soc. A 368, 3379 (2010); the potential parameters can be extracted from the literature.

access.notes: Known from standard sources (e.g., ICSD). Wurtzite GaN lattice constants: a=3.189 Å, c=5.185 Å, internal parameter u=0.375.
